scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was inspected at the model parameter table, the dimensional reproduction-number formula, and the first-dose sensitivity subsection and contour plot. A closely related Jakarta measles vaccination model was inspected at its model, reproduction-number, and vaccination-control sections. Exact rational replay verifies the source-parameter floor and the inadmissible formal crossing. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns the first-dose-only reproduction-number slice obtained by setting second-dose vaccination and treatment to zero. It does not assess combined strategies, transient incidence, or cost-effectiveness.

title: Imperfect first-dose vaccination has a hard measles threshold floor
